findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, facility has multiple CFM’s however none were available during inspection. Ensure a certified food manager is present during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed mold accumulation to be present at bar soda gun. Discussed with PIC, soda gun was cleaned with a sanitizing rag. Ensure soda gun is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple open juices to be missing date marking. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and dates were added to juices. Ensure after 24 hours any open TCS items is properly date marked.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed in use ice scoop to be resting in ice bin. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and ice scoop was placed handle side up. Ensure ice scoop handle is not in contact with ice to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(A) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) Except as specified under (B) of this section, in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, facility has multiple CFM’s however none were available during inspection. Ensure a certified food manager is present during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed member of staff to not use a barrier when turning off handwashing faucet. Discussed with employee, education on proper hand washing was provided and employee rewashed hands. Ensure staff is properly washing hands to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer to be set up upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, triple sink was set up and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure sanitizer is set up during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. 
(B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the pizza grates of the pizza oven to be heavily soiled. Ensure the tray and the grate are cleaned routinely - wash, rinse, sanitize. Tray was clean. Employee began to clean during the inspection. Ensure staff is aware. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink in the back area (next to the pizza oven) has a mop head and sign sitting on top of it as well as multiple empty beer kegs in front of it. A discussion took place in relation to hand sinks being maintained as accessible at all times and the items blocking th sink were removed to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The ice machine in the bar area is observed with black mold on the scoop holder and along the ice tray as well as pink slime on the ice scoop holder. PIC cleaned during the inspection to correct and is instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation of filth.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) In the prep cooler, containers of salami and sliced onions are observed with date marks of 11/10. This makes today day 9 and the limit is 7 days. The situation was discussed with the PIC and the 2 containers discarded during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) The dish machine and the three part sink in the bar both use a chlorine (CL) based chemical for sanitizing. The PIC could only produce test strips intended for Quaternary Ammonia during the inspection. The PIC was instructed to acquire test strips intended to CL. Inspector gave the PIC enough test strips for a couple days. The violation is considered corrected at this time.
